description: This file defines the MessageInterface interface for HTTP message objects, including methods for handling protocol version, headers, and body streams within the PSR-7 standard.

classes.name: MessageInterface
classes.description: Interface for HTTP message objects, specifying methods for protocol version, headers, and body management.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP protocol version as a string.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP protocol version.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves all message header values as an associative array.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header exists by case-insensitive name.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves all values for a given header name.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Retrieves a comma-separated string of header values.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided header set.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the header appended with a value.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Retrieves the message body as a stream.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified message body.
